limitations: Different real OSM geometry with synthetic mapped demand and depot locations, not observed UM demand or evidence of legal deployability. Same frozen undirected flat-road physics and dispatch policies. No third policy; no tuning based on pilot or confirmation. Pilot seed excluded from inference.
primary_estimand: Mean paired battery saving, 100*(off-on)/off, per seed in each of 8 cells; network and arrival-window difference-in-differences in percentage points (UM minus UTP, 600 minus 1800)
service_guard: Descriptive guard: unadjusted 95% CI lower bound for on-minus-off completed requests strictly above -1 per 100, as well as positive energy saving with Holm p<0.05. Not formal joint noninferiority.
